description: This file defines the PresenceReporter class responsible for periodically sending system presence information (such as IP, host name, version, and input activity) in a MacOS application. It manages a background task to push updates and includes methods for composing and sending presence data.

classes.name: PresenceReporter
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for periodically reporting the system's presence status to an external control channel.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the background task to periodically push presence updates.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the ongoing presence update task.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Assembles presence data and sends it via the control channel.

methods.name: sendImmediate
methods.description: Triggers an immediate presence push, typically on connect.

methods.name: composePresenceSummary
methods.description: Creates a human-readable summary string of the current presence state.

methods.name: appVersionString
methods.description: Retrieves the application's version string, combining short version and build.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with the macOS version.
